Overview

Interlaken is a city in Bern with a population of 6,000. Switzerland’s adventure capital nestled between Lake Thun and Lake Brienz, with views of the Eiger, Mönch, and Jungfrau peaks, and gateway to the Jungfraujoch. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
